breakdown.description: The task is a variable-cell relaxation, but the later instruction freezes the lattice vectors and allows only internal-coordinate relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The original prompt requested a `vc-relax` (variable-cell) but then incorrectly stated to keep the lattice vectors fixed. The ground truth corrects this by removing the instruction to fix the lattice. The Agent, however, repeated the error, explicitly stating to 'Keep the lattice vectors fixed during the ionic relaxation' and even combined the contradictory concepts into 'Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) calculation with fixed cell vectors', which is nonsensical.
